subject: Dedicated pool ops walkthrough and sizing decisioning
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@synthex.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T10:15:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated vs Hosted - post demo recap

Alicia — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size a recommended Dedicated pool and route next steps: 

Summary from call:
- Synthex wants predictable latency for production ML inference and data isolation for customer PII flows.
- Primary traffic: conversational assistant + multimodal enrichment.
- Preference leaning toward Dedicated (reserved capacity) but want cost/throughput tradeoffs vs Hosted.

Asks to finalize sizing:
1) Target sustained TPS (inference calls/sec) and expected burst TPS. If you have 90/95/99% traffic breakdowns that helps.
2) Typical token mix: average prompt tokens / avg response tokens / 95th percentile length.
3) Target p95 latency SLO (ms) and whether 100–200ms is required.
4) Any on-prem/VPC requirement for a subset of customers or full private deployment?
5) Preferred model family (we can run benchmarks on a 70B+ vs 13B based on cost).

Attached: initial-sizing-worksheet.xlsx — fill the orange fields and return and we’ll produce a Dedicated options sheet (GPU mix + concurrency recommendations).

Proposed next steps:
- You fill the worksheet and attach any traffic samples (csv) — we’ll produce two proposals: H100-optimized pool and A100 cost-optimized pool.
- Schedule a technical deep dive with our infra engs for benchmarking (30–45m).

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if easier.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

[Attachment: initial-sizing-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@synthex.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Synthex Procurement <procure@synthex.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated vs Hosted - post demo recap

Thanks Ben — appreciated the clear rundown. Answers below and attached a small traffic sample.

Answers:
- Sustained TPS: 85 TPS baseline; burst to 140 TPS during peaks (we expect spikes during product launches).
- Token mix: prompt avg ~120 tokens, response avg ~80 tokens. 95p token length ~900 tokens (long sessions occur ~5% of calls).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms ideally; for top-tier users we’d accept <150ms.
- Private constraints: most workloads fine in Dedicated hosted within our region, but two enterprise customers require VPC/air-gapped options for model inputs (could be staged later).
- Model family: preference to evaluate both a 13B distilled and a 70B moderate model — main goal is cost + latency balance.

We attached synthex_traffic_sample.csv (anonymized). Budget: initial committed spend target ~$40k/month but open to justification if performance materially better on H100.

Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Head of ML Platform, Synthex Labs
alicia@synthex.ai

[Attachment: synthex_traffic_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Moreno <alicia@synthex.ai>
Date: 2026-06-03T09:05:00Z
Subject: Internal: sizing options to propose (H100 vs A100) + questions for Alicia

Neha/Marcus — moving Alicia's answers into a quick ops check. I want to draft two distinct proposals:
A) Performance-first: H100 heavy pool to hit p95 <150ms for top-tier users, support bursts ~180 TPS.
B) Cost-first: A100-based pool with aggressive batching/kv-caching aiming p95 <250ms, sustained 85 TPS, bursts to 140.

Open questions for the tech notes we should include back to Alicia:
- Based on token mix (avg 200 total tokens, 95p up to 900), what effective RTX memory and batch size do we recommend for 70B vs 13B?
- For the H100 option, how many cards/instances for baseline 85 TPS with headroom to 180 TPS? (estimate concurrency slots and qps per card)
- For A100, what batching settings and quantization would you recommend to keep latency acceptable for 95p 900-token sessions?
- KV/prefix caching impact on sustained cost; assumptions we should call out (cache hit %, warmup behavior).

Attached: redwood-dedicated-options.pdf — will convert once we have numbers.

Ben
[Attachment: redwood-dedicated-options.pdf (pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Moreno <alicia@synthex.ai>
Date: 2026-06-04T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: sizing options to propose (H100 vs A100) + questions for Alicia

Ben / Marcus — quick engineering read on the asks (high level numbers, will confirm with perf team during benchmark):

Assumptions from Alicia sample: avg total tokens ~200, 95p ~900, 5% long-tail. Model family TBD: we’ll benchmark a 13B float and a 70B int8/4-bit quantized profile.

Prelim guidance:
- 70B (quantized/optimized pipeline): H100-80GB recommended for aggressive latency; expect ~12–18 qps per GPU for long-token sessions (900 tokens) depending on batching. For 85 TPS sustained we’d recommend 6x H100-80GB GPUs (gives headroom for bursts to ~160–180 TPS with autoscaling/burst slots).
- 13B (int8): A100-40GB / A100-80GB can deliver ~40–80 qps per GPU for the token mix; for cost-first path 2–3 x A100-80GB GPUs could cover sustained 85 TPS with bursts to 140 if we enable dynamic batching and prefix/KV caching.
- Concurrency slots: recommend starting with 4 slots per GPU for 70B (slot = concurrent requests allowed), concurrency 8 for 13B.
- Latency: with tuned kernels and aggressive batching, H100 path expected p95 <150ms for most calls; A100 path p95 near 200–300ms for long-tail sessions — need to call out long-session tail.
- Caching: if Synthex can leverage prefix caching for repeated prompts (chat history), we can save 20–40% tokens on average. We should model both with conservative 10% cache hit and an optimistic 30% hit in the proposal.

Risk notes:
- Long 900-token 95p sessions push memory and increase per-token compute; quantify in the proposal and include a recommended fall-back (reroute long jobs to a lower-cost batch queue or model variant).

I’ll draft two SKU/cost sheets and expected latency curves. We should include a small benchmark plan (see Ben’s ask).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Technical Solutions, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: gpu-recs-notes.md (text)]

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@synthex.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Synthex Procurement <procure@synthex.ai>
Date: 2026-06-05T14:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up / proposal direction

Thanks — the numbers look reasonable. We discussed internally and prefer to move forward with a Dedicated H100-optimized pool for initial launch for performance-critical customers, with a plan to evaluate a lower-cost A100 pool for non-critical workloads.

Commitment / asks:
- Initial committed target: 100 TPS sustained (we can start at 85 but want committed at 100), burst to 180 TPS.
- Please include a recommended autoscale policy and expected latency at 100 TPS for both 70B and 13B candidates.
- Compliance: we need SOC2 evidence and a pointer to your data retention/audit logs policy for the Dedicated tenancy.
- Procurement: cc’ed procure@synthex.ai to start PO process (they will need a mutual action plan and invoice schedule).

Attaching a short M.A.P. draft to get the contracting track started. If we can get a benchmark within 7–10 business days and a mutually agreed plan, procurement is comfortable to progress.

Alicia

[Attachment: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v0.1.docx (docx)]

Subject: Next steps and timeline — Dedicated H100 path (recap)

Alicia / team — thanks, and great to have alignment on the H100-led path for initial launch. Recap & immediate next steps: 

1) Benchmarks / technical deep dive (owners: Neha + Marcus) — schedule in the next 5 business days. Goal: run 70B + 13B baseline tests on H100 and A100 to validate p95 at 100 TPS sustained and burst behavior. (Deliverable: benchmark report + recommended GPU count and autoscale ladder).
2) Sizing & pricing proposal (owner: Ben) — I’ll send formal SKU docs for H100 and A100 options including committed/overage pricing and expected monthly costs based on 100 TPS.
3) Compliance package (owner: Security) — provide SOC2 artifact pointer + Dedicated tenancy controls. I’ve added the HubSpot deal link and the MAP for procurement.
4) Procurement (owner: Synthex Procurement + Ben) — Alicia / procure to issue PO; we’ll respond with a SOW and DocuSign.

Action items and timeline (proposed):
- 06/07–06/11: benchmarking window (we’ll request short test tokens and synthetic traffic from Synthex).
- 06/12: deliver benchmark report and draft SKU pricing.
- 06/15: finalize MAP and send DocuSign SOW.

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/36712/DEAL-453
- Sizing sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SyNThex-size-sheet

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
